reports.title: PPL Corporation Delivers Strong Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings;

lines: •Narrows 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range to $1.92 to $1.96 per share; on track to achieve at least the midpoint of $1.94 per share.

•Increases long-term annual EPS growth target to 7% to 9% through at least 2030 off of the company’s 2026 ongoing earnings forecast midpoint; expects annual EPS growth in the top half of the targeted range.
•Provides 2027 earnings forecast range of $2.06 to $2.14 per share; midpoint of $2.10 per share represents an 8.2% increase over PPL’s projected 2026 ongoing earnings midpoint.

“Our strong third-quarter results reflect continued execution across PPL and keep us on track to meet or exceed the $1.94 per share midpoint of our 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range,” said Vincent Sorgi, PPL President and Chief Executive Officer.

With PPL’s updated business plan, the company increased its annual EPS growth target to 7% to 9% through at least 2030 off of the company’s 2026 ongoing earnings forecast midpoint, with annual growth expected in the top half of the range.
In conjunction with today’s business plan update, PPL provided a 2027 earnings forecast range of $2.06 to $2.14 per share.
